CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetTimeZoneInfo

Returns a structure with the server's offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and whether daylight saving time is in effect.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

GetTimeZoneInfo()

Returns

A structure with four keys:

Key Contents
utcTotalOffset Seconds to add to local time to get UTC. Positive west of Greenwich (US Eastern Standard Time is 18000).
utcHourOffset Whole hours of the offset, with the same sign.
utcMinuteOffset Remaining minutes (0 for most zones, 30 for places such as India).
isDSTOn YES if daylight saving time is in effect right now.

Usage

The sign convention trips people up: the offset is what you add to local time to reach UTC, so a server in Berlin (one hour ahead of UTC in winter) reports -3600. DateConvert does the arithmetic for you.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET TZ = GetTimeZoneInfo()>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Key</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>utcTotalOffset</TD><TD>#TZ.utcTotalOffset#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>utcHourOffset</TD><TD>#TZ.utcHourOffset#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>utcMinuteOffset</TD><TD>#TZ.utcMinuteOffset#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>isDSTOn</TD><TD>#TZ.isDSTOn#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
